resetPassword.title: Set a new passcode
resetPassword.missingToken: This link is missing its reset token — use the link from your email exactly as sent.
resetPassword.done: Passcode reset. Redirecting to sign in...

nodeDetails.title: Node details
nodeDetails.selectHint: Click a node to see its scores.

causalImpact.title: Causal Impact (top spreaders)
causalImpact.empty: No causal impact scores yet — run the graph analysis first, then compute causal impact.

propagation.title: Propagation Replay
propagation.noTopics: No topics yet — run trend detection first.
propagation.empty: This topic has no time-ordered post data to replay yet.

trends.emptyState: No trending topics yet — run the synthetic data generator, then Run trend detection.

sentiment.emptyState: No scored posts yet — run the synthetic data generator, then Run NLP processing to classify them.
sentiment.sarcasmNote: Sarcasm detection runs per-post (English only, explicitly experimental) but isn't surfaced in this aggregate timeline view.

demographics.emptyState: No demographic aggregates yet — run network analysis first (communities are required), then Run demographic aggregation.
demographics.privacyNote: Aggregate-only, per community, with differential-privacy-style noise applied — never tied to an individual user. Small groups are suppressed entirely rather than shown with low confidence.

ledger.title: Ledger / Audit Trail
ledger.brokenMsg: Chain integrity BROKEN at block index {{index}}.

admin.title: Admin — Pending Approvals
admin.loadError: Failed to load pending users (Admin role required).

live.modeNote: never silently substituted for live data
live.body: Real-time X/Telegram feed, live counters, and the India Mood emotion panel stream in here once the live ingestion pipeline is connected.

network.body: Graph view, centrality filters, node detail panel, and Propagation Replay render here once graph construction and causal influence scoring are implemented.

sentiment.body: Sentiment/emotion time series, filterable by community, topic, and India-association tag, once the multilingual NLP pipeline is wired in.

trends.body: Ranked current and predicted-rising topics, velocity-scored rather than volume-ranked, once trend detection is implemented.

demographics.body: Aggregate-only charts per community — never a per-user demographic label — with calibrated noise applied, once demographic aggregation is implemented.

settings.body: Role management, ingestion job status, influence-score weight configuration, and MFA management land here as remaining build steps are completed.
